article.title: Adobe擴展Creative Agent，預覽第三方代理編輯原生專案
article.title_en: Adobe expands Creative Agent and previews third-party editing of native projects
article.summary: Adobe MAX公布Creative Agent擴展至Firefly與Creative Cloud，另展示第三方代理接入原生專案的預覽。
article.summary_en: Adobe MAX announced Creative Agent expansion across Firefly and Creative Cloud, with a preview of third-party agents accessing native projects.
highlights: Adobe亦宣布把CX Enterprise Coworker帶入GenStudio。
highlights_en: The preview covers Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere and After Effects.
Adobe also announced CX Enterprise Coworker for GenStudio.
article.why: 創意團隊可開始評估哪些重複修改適合交給代理，並為原生專案保留版本及審閱紀錄。
article.why_en: Creative teams can assess repeatable edits while keeping project versions and review records.
article.next_step: 選一個可重做的修改任務，列出檔案權限、版本保留及人工審閱要求。
article.next_step_en: Pick one reversible edit and define file permissions, version retention and human review.
article.detail: 本機MCP接入是讓第三方代理與創意工具溝通的預覽。Adobe描述的是代理可在原生專案檔案提出或執行修改的方向，各項工具的正式開放安排仍需逐一確認。團隊評估時可先用複製檔，檢查圖層、字型、色彩及輸出是否符合品牌要求，再決定哪些修改可納入正式製作流程。
article.detail_en: Local MCP integration is a preview of how third-party agents can work with creative tools and edit native projects. Check availability for each application. Start with a copy and validate layers, fonts, colour and output before using the workflow in production.
